thought.text: No system python3 (uv-only environment). Let me use the workspace venv's Python:

reasoning_content: python3 isn't installed on the system (only uv-managed). Either use uv's python or install python3. The workspace's venv has python. Let's use /workspace/.venv/bin/python.

action.command:
nohup /workspace/.venv/bin/python /workspace/.local-services/llm_stub.py > /tmp/llm-stub.log 2>&1 &
echo "llm stub pid $!"
sleep 2
echo "=== models ==="; curl -sS http://localhost:8000/v1/models; echo
echo "=== chat ==="; curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"spark-local-text","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"response_format":{"type":"json_object"}}' | head -c 300; echo
echo "=== embeddings (dim check) ==="; curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/embeddings -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"spark-local-embeddings-1024","input":"test"}' | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('dim:', len(d['data'][0]['embedding']))"
